content: Jerusalén-dulemar sui-dikarba-yolesadyob gued
Bab-Jehová anga sogded:
“Dule-machi, Jerusalén-dulemar e-ibmar-isgana-imakdiid ega be soge.
Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi weyob sogye: ‘Jerusalén-neggwebur, be Canaán-yargi danikid, agi be gwalulesad. Be-bab, Amorreo-duled, be-nandi, Het-duled.
Be-gwalulesad-ibagi be-ibe simudub siksasurmalad, be-ogsasurmalad, balugi be-magsasurmalad, deginbali, simu-edugega bega morgo edichasurmarbalid.
Weyob be-imakegala, dule-wargwensaale, gwen bai be-daksasulid, deginbali, dule wile-be-daksasurbalid. Be-gwalulesad-ibagi, aka bur ibmar-isganayob sapurba be-metemalad.
” ’An be-nagaba nasa gusad, napagi be-ablisgi-moodmai an be-daksad. Ablisbi-moodomai an be-daksagua, ¡dula gudisaye! an bega sogsad.

Gagan-nuedyobi dunguoye, an bega sogsad. ” ’Be dungude gusad, be yalenonikid, geb be yeerdakle gunonikid. Be nuu-mulluu guded, degi, be-sailagia yeer daklenaded. Ar degi-inigwele, amba bedi uka-swana gudii gusad.

” ’A-ibagan-nasad-sorbali, an gannar be-nagaba nasbalid, degi, bato be sui-nikuedgin an be-daksad. Geb degine, an-mor-dummad an bega uksad. A-morgine an be-obirmaksad. An bega ise-sogar sogsad, degi, an bebo igar-mesisad, geb angadga be-gunonisunnad. Ani an Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi weyob soged.
” ’An be-ogsad, an bega ablis elisad, geb ina-wawadikidgi an be-magsad.
Dubgi-sobaled-mor an bega yosad. Nag-uka ibmar-ukagi-sobaled an bega yosad. Lino-dubgi-mor-makaled, degi, sedaʼgi-mor-makaled an bega yosad.
Ormar galagwensuli an bega nasiksad: Sakwagi-nagumalad, dukargi-nagumalad,
uayagi-nagumalad, olasu an bega yosad, degi, orgurgin-yeerdakleged nonogi an bega sisbalid.

Deyobi, be orbi, manibi, biini gudii gusad. Lino-dubgi-mor-makaled-mor, seda-dubgi-mor-makaled, degi, dubgi-sobaled-mor, be yoi gudii gusad. Trigo-bur-nued be gundii gusad, achanis be madii gusad, degi, olivo-gwalluba be mas gundii gusad. Bela-bela be yeerdakle gunonikid, be rey-omeyob-dakle gunonikid.

Be-yeerdakleged-ulale, dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukwamalad-abargi be-nug dummarbaa gunonikid. Ar ade, ani an bur-birigine yeerdakle be-imaksad. Ani an Bab-Dummad-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi weyob soged.
” ’Ar degi-inigwele, be-yeerdaklegedgi be gannarbaa-itosad. Be-nug-dummarba-nikadba be gambanuchu-imakde gusad. Gwen bingedsuli be yogasaar dulemarga san-urmakdii gusad.
Napa-nibakwagwad-birgi Bab-dummadyob-ibmar-imaklegedse-goled-neg be-mormargi be sobsad. A-neggi galagwensuli be gusad. ¡Bipisaar deyob ibmar gwen dakledisulid!
Ormar-galagwensulidgi, degi, mani-an-bega-uksadgi, macherganyob-dakle be ibmar-wilub sobsad. Geb amar-e-nug be odummosad.
Amarga be-mor-dubgi-sobaled be yosad, degi, an-olivo-gwallu ega be uksad, an-ina-wawad ega be uksabalid.
An bega mas uksa-gusad: Trigo-bur-nued, olivo-gwallu, degi, achanis. We-masmar ega be ibmar-wawadik-yapanned-uklegedyob uksa gusad. Ani an Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi weyob soged.
” ’Deginbali, an bebo machimala, degi, bunamala-baksagusad be susbalid. Geb be wemar bab-dummadyob-ibmar-imakleged-e-masga-gumalaga be oburgwisad. Be-galagwensuli-gudiid amba be nubin itossulid.
Ar ade, be an-mimmigan oburgwisbalid. Geb bab-dummadyob-ibmar-imaklemaladga ibmar-uklegedyob be soogi ogumakar uksad.
Bela be-ibmar-isgana-imakedba, be-galagwensuli-nanaedba, igi be bipigwaun-gudigusa be ieded, egi bar be binsassulid. Deunni, be uka-swana-gudigusad, be-ablisgi be moodmaigusad, bela be ieded.’ ”
Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi soged: “¡Be duledar-wiles! ¡Be duledar-wiles! Ar be bela ibmar-isgana imaksadginbali,
be bela neg-ollornanaidgi gambanuchu-megmalad-neg sobsabalid.

Bela igarmar abingunanaidgi, gambanuchu-megmalad-neg be sobsad. Degi, be-yeerdakleged ibmar-isgana-daklegedyob be imaksad. Be yogasaar dulemarga na san-urmakdii-gusad, degi, galagwensuli-gudiid gwen be bogilessulid.
Egipto-dulemarbo be galagwensuli-gudii gusad. Wemar na dulemar-dutusurmaladid. An-ourwega, aka bur bule be gambanuchu-imakdii gusad.

Degisoggu, an sabsur-be-odurdaksasunnad. A-ulale, an be-ibe be-yar-abar-sumalaga imaksad. Filistea-dulemarga an be-urmaksa gusad, wemar isdar-be-dakmaladid, degi, be-galagwensur-gudiidgi bingegudimaladid.
Deginbali, Asiria-dulemarbo be gannar-gannar galagwensuli-gudii gusbalid, ar degite, amba be nubin itossulid.
Ar amba deyobi, be Babilonia-dulemar-ibmar-ukmaladbo galagwensuli-gudii gusbalid, ar degite, amba be nubin itossurbalid.”
Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi soged: “¡Ibiyobi sunnasur be binsae! ¡Gambanuchu-bingedsulidyob be nanadii gusad!

Bela igarmar-abingunanaidgi, gambanuchu-megmalad-neg be sobsagusad, degi, bela neg-ollornanaidgi, gambanuchu-megmalad-neg be sobsagusad. Ar degi-inigwele, bedi gambanuchu-daedyob gussulid, ar be gwen mani-gassulid.
”Ome-negsichigi-nanadiiyobi be gued. Be be-suibina-sogedba bur bule machergan-bamaladbina be soged.
Bela gambanuchumar bennuklemalad, ar aka bedi na bebo-galagwensuli-gudimalad bennuked. Bela dulemar-yar-baid-baidginmaladga be mani-ukdaed, adi, bebo galagwensuli gudamalagar.

Be gambanuchu-imakdiidgi, bedi omegan-bamaladba akarsaila gusad. Ar bebo galagwensuliguega, dulemar bar be-amisulid, deginbali, be-bennuksurbalid, aka bur bedi amar-bennuked. Weyob-daedgi, bedi gambanuchu-imakmaladbo akalad.”
Degisoggu, gambanuchu, Bab-Jehová ibmar-soged be itoge.
Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi weyob soged: “Na bebo galagwensuli-gudiidga, degi, be-bab-dummadyob-ibmar-imakdiidga, be bingesuli be-abgan oyodii gusad. Amarga be-mimmigan-e-ablis be ukdii nanasad.

Degidbali, bela bebo-galagwensuli-gusmaladi, amar-yeer-itogega be imaksadi, be sabgusgusadi, be isdar-daksabalidi, wemar an danar urboed. Be-dikarba an amar-urboed, geb amar-asabin an uka-swili be-ogwichoed. Bela amar uka-swana be-dakmaloed.
Ome-e-sui-dikarba-yolegedyob, degi, dule-gindakedyob an bega igar-nabogedgi sabsur-odurdaked an mesoed. An bela-bela sae-itosoggu, burgwega an be-imakoed.

Bebo-galagwensuli-gusmaladga an be-urmakoed, geb amar be-gambanuchu-samalad-neg earmaloed, degi, be-bab-dummagan-e-ailamar omukumaloed. Be-ibe mor sumaloed, be-ormar-galagwensulid sumarbaloed. Uka-swana be-obemaloed.
Dule-bukidar-begi-aibinega imakmaloed. Akwagi be-makmaloed, geb es-suidgi olo-olo be-imakmaloed.
Be-negmar ogumakmaloed, geb omegan-bukidarad-wagab deyob be-imakmaloed. Be-gambanuchu-imakdiid an obelogoed, bebo galagwensuli-gudimalad be bar bennukosulid.
Weyobi, an-urwed bogilegoed, an-nobgued berguoed. Bar an urwesuli, bogidik megoed.
”Ar be na bipigwaun-gudigusad ebinsassursoggu, degi, be-galagwensuli-gudigusadgi be an-oulussoggu, a-ulale, an sabsur-be-odurdakoed. Ani an Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi weyob soged.
”Dulemar-deyob-sogleged-gusgu-sogmaladi, weyob begi sogmaloed: ‘Na e-nan daedyobi, e-bunor damoye.’

Be-nanyobi be damogad. Be-nan na e-sui, degi, na e-mimmigan isdar-daksagusad. Be-ioryob, be-urbayob be damogad, na e-suimar, degi, na e-mimmigan isdar-daksagusmalad. Be-nana, Het-duled, be-babdi, Amorreo-duled.
Samaria, be-iorad, na e-neggwebur-burwiganmala be-dad-nakwed-argan-sapiledsik siid. Sodoma, be-urbad, na e-neggwebur-burwiganmala be-dad-nakwed-argan-nuedsik siid.
Unnila wemar-daedbarbi be nanadii gussulid, e-ibmar-isgana-imakdiid be imaksabalid. Wemarba bur bule be isgusad.

Ani an Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi na dukin ise-sogar-soged: Ar be, degi, dulemar-be-neggwebur-burwiganginmalad igi ibmar-imaksamala, deyobi, be-urba-Sodoma, degi, dulemar-e-neggwebur-burwiganginmalad bipisaar ibmar-imaksasurmalad.

”Be-urba-Sodoma, degi, dulemar-e-neggwebur-burwiganginmalad na san-dummarba-imakedgi, mas-obinebaka-nikadgi, degi, dule-gwen-bai-daksulidgi isgusmalad. Deginbali, dule-wileged, degi, dule-ibmar-sate-gudiid bendaksasulidgi na isgusmarbalid.
Dule-bamaladba na san-dummarbaa itodii gusmalad, an-asabin ibmar-isgana-imaksamalad. A-ulale, an deyob-daksagua, an obelosad.
Degi-inigwele, Samaria, degi, dulemar-e-neggwebur-burwiganginmalad be-isgusadyobi isgussurmalad. Ar bedi we-dulemarba bur bule ibmar-isgana imaksad, ar bebo wilubsadele, beba bur dule-nued gumalad.

Emigindi, be bingegudii gusunna, ar be-iorba, degi, be-urbaba be bur bule ibmar-isgana imaksasoggu, be-ior, degi, be-urba beba bur dule-nuedyob daklesunnad. Be bingegusunna, begi dodoledii gusunna. Ar be-ior, degi, be-urba, beba bur dule-nueddaedyob be imaksad.

”Degi-inigwele, an Sodoma-dulemar, degi, e-neggwebur-burwigan gannar nasguega an imakoed. Deginbali, Samaria-dulemar, degi, e-neggwebur-burwigan, gannar nasguega an imakbaloed. An deyobi, gannar be-imakmogoed.
Deyobi, begi dodoledii gusunnoed, ibmar-imaksadba be bingegudii guoed. Geb amarga gwage-gadi-gadi-imakedga be guoed.
Be-urba-Sodoma e-neggwebur-burwiganmala, be-ior-Samaria e-neggwebur-burwiganmala, iduar sigisadyob gannar signonimaloed. Be, be-neggwebur-burwiganmala iduar-sigisadyob be gannar signonimarmogoed.
Amba-yoo be-isgued-wisgulegu, be san-dummarbaa itodii gusad,
be-urba-Sodomaʼgi be dododii gusad. Ar emigindi, Siria-dulemar, Filistea-dulemar begi dodomalad. ¡Bela isdar be-dakmalad!
Be-doggus-galagwensuli-gudigusad, degi, be-ibmar-isgana-imaksadi be sedii gusunye. Ani an Bab-Jehová-guedi weyob soged.”
Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi weyob sogbalid: “An sabsur-be-odurdakoed, ar ade, be ibmar-ise-sogar-sogsad gwen be imaksasulid. Be anbo-igar-mesisadgi be annasad.
Degi-inigwele, andi be-bipigwaun an-bebo-igar-mesisad ebinsaoed, geb igar-degisadeguad an bebo mesoed.
An bega be-ior, be-urba, be-bunamalaga-guega uksale, iduar be nanadigusad ebinsadoed, degi, be bingegudabaloed. Degi-inigwele, amba wemar an bebo-igar-mesisadgi dogosurmalad.
An bebo igar mesoed. Be wisguoed, ani an Bab-Jehová gue.
An bela be-isgusad bega elinonikile, be-ibmar-isgana-imaksad be ebinsaoed, geb be bingegudoed. Na be-bingegued-ular, bar be sunmakosulid. Ani an Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi weyob soged.”
